headline: Divided Fronts Stir as Base Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: The latest watch shows the struggle shifting toward several contested sectors, with new movement since the previous edition. Stlican Shelf has sharpened its activity, recording seven strategic-base events in the newest two hours and 11 in six, while its holdings remain five Colonial, two Warden, and two neutral. Godcrofts has also come alive, with four events in two hours and nine in six; its ledger stands seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral. Deadlands records two fresh events, amid sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments, while its bases remain ten Colonial to one Warden. Callahan’s Passage remains the heaviest active front by casualty volume, with two events in two hours and accelerating enlistment, though all ten bases are still Warden-held. Stonecradle continues its divided contest with three recent events and a five-to-four Warden advantage. Weathered Expanse has gone quiet in the newest two hours but logged nine events in six and remains six Colonial to three Warden. Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow show no fresh two-hour movement, despite substantial earlier activity; many other sectors remain strategically still.
